# Citation verification (generated by scripts/build_citation_verification.py)

Scope: only keys cited in the manuscript (38). Each `references.bib` entry is copied from `research/literature/VERIFIED_REFERENCES.bib` (never invented; `scripts/build_bib.py` asserts this). `scripts/check_manuscript.py` confirms every `\cite` key resolves.

## Access limits (from the evidence matrix and NOVELTY_REASSESSMENT_PHASE2.md sections 6-7)
- Matrix: 185 rows; FULL TEXT 20 (8 own read, 12 tool-mediated), ABSTRACT 89, METADATA 76, so 109 of 185 (59%) are abstract or metadata only. Tool-mediated reads covered roughly the first 100,000 characters; silence in them is weak evidence of absence.
- ACM Digital Library returned HTTP 403 for every ACM DOI attempted (including re-observation on 2026-11-18); ACM metadata was verified via Crossref only. Shadow TOSEM 2018 is abstract-only; Evans and Savoia was read from an Internet Archive copy of the authors' PDF.
- Not read at all (metadata or abstract only) include Shadow TOSEM full text, Jin et al. 2010, DiffGen, Godefroid REST differential regression, DiffKemp TOSEM 2026, verification-witness papers, abstention and flakiness papers. Prior art for the novelty items may exist that the reviewer could not rule out.
- Single reviewer, known-item and gap-driven search (not systematic), no second screener; 2026 preprints may change; arXiv ids 2607.* and 2610.* were verified only through the live arXiv API on the stated date. No third-party tool was run and no published number reproduced; the manuscript makes no comparison with any of them.

## Bibliography discrepancies listed in NOVELTY_REASSESSMENT_PHASE2.md section 6 (flagged, NOT fixed)
1. `malik2026diffkemp`: confirmed from Crossref metadata (10.1145/3801958, Malik, Vojnar, Necas, TOSEM 2026) that the title equals the ICST 2021 paper `malik2021`; whether it is the journal extension or a mis-assigned DOI is unconfirmed beyond Crossref. Flagged; manuscript cites it with a hedge.
2. ArXiv-first year in key versus publication year in the year field: `pradel2025testora` (2026), `liu2025evaluating` (2026), `etemadi2024mokav` (2025). Key naming only; no mismatch in title, authors or venue was found. Keys left unchanged (renaming would diverge from VERIFIED_REFERENCES.bib).
3. 11 evidence-matrix rows have `NOT VERIFIED` in `key` (DOI not recorded): Chianti IBM tech report RC22983; An Empirical Comparison of Dynamic Impact Analysis Algo; Automatically detecting equivalent mutants and infeasib; Differential testing for software; Randomized Differential Testing as a Prelude to Formal ; Badger: complexity analysis with fuzzing and symbolic e; Online Defect Prediction for Imbalanced Data; It's not a bug, it's a feature: How misclassification i; Defects4J: a database of existing faults to enable cont; BugsInPy; QuixBugs. None of these is a cited key unless listed below as NOT VERIFIED.
4. `leCong2026patchguru`: arXiv API title was truncated in the first printed line; treated as OK pending a full-title check (novelty file).
